description: Land Title Settlement Department - Batugedara, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620293 (23/120)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and property rights for specific land parcels in Ratnapura District. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized administrative matters.
